Roth.Θ_lt : ∀ (n : ℕ) {δ : ℝ},
  0 < δ →
    ∀ {r q : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ},
      3 ≤ ↑(r (Fin.last n)) →
        (∀ (i : Fin n), ↑(r i.succ) ≤ δ * ↑(r i.castSucc)) →
          (↑n + 1) * (2 * (↑n + 1) + 1) / δ ≤ Real.log ↑(q 0) →
            (∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)), ↑(r 0) * Real.log ↑(q 0) ≤ ↑(r j) * Real.log ↑(q j)) →
              Roth.Θ (↑(q 0) ^ (δ * ↑(r 0))) q r < 10 ^ (n + 1) * δ ^ (1 / 2) ^ (n + 1)

theorem Roth.Θ_lt : ∀ (n : ℕ) {δ : ℝ},
  0 < δ →
    ∀ {r q : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ},
      3 ≤ ↑(r (Fin.last n)) →
        (∀ (i : Fin n), ↑(r i.succ) ≤ δ * ↑(r i.castSucc)) →
          (↑n + 1) * (2 * (↑n + 1) + 1) / δ ≤ Real.log ↑(q 0) →
            (∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)), ↑(r 0) * Real.log ↑(q 0) ≤ ↑(r j) * Real.log ↑(q j)) →
              Roth.Θ (↑(q 0) ^ (δ * ↑(r 0))) q r < 10 ^ (n + 1) * δ ^ (1 / 2) ^ (n + 1) :=
fun n {δ} hδ0 {r q} hrlast hratio hq1 hqr ↦
  Nat.recAux (motive := fun n ↦
    ∀ {δ : ℝ},
      0 < δ →
        ∀ {r q : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ},
          3 ≤ ↑(r (Fin.last n)) →
            (∀ (i : Fin n), ↑(r i.succ) ≤ δ * ↑(r i.castSucc)) →
              (↑n + 1) * (2 * (↑n + 1) + 1) / δ ≤ Real.log ↑(q 0) →
                (∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)), ↑(r 0) * Real.log ↑(q 0) ≤ ↑(r j) * Real.log ↑(q j)) →
                  Roth.Θ (↑(q 0) ^ (δ * ↑(r 0))) q r < 10 ^ (n + 1) * δ ^ (1 / 2) ^ (n + 1))
    (fun {δ} hδ0 {r q} hrlast hratio hq1 hqr ↦
      have hr :=
        cast (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg LT.lt (Eq.symm Nat.cast_zero)) ↑(r 0)) Nat.cast_lt._simp_1)
          (lt_of_lt_of_le
            (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_lt_true (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_zero)
              (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 3)) (Eq.refl false))
            (Eq.mpr (id Nat.ofNat_le_cast._simp_1)
              (Eq.mp
                (Eq.trans (congrArg (LE.le 3) (congrArg Nat.cast (congrArg r Fin.last_zero))) Nat.ofNat_le_cast._simp_1)
                hrlast)));
      if hδ : δ ≤ 1 then
        Roth.theta_lt_base_aux✝ hδ0 hδ hr
          (Roth.theta_denominators_one_lt_aux✝ hr
            (lt_of_lt_of_le
              (div_pos
                (mul_pos
                  (Right.add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (Nat.cast_nonneg' 0)
                    (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_one)
                      (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 1))))
                  (add_pos'
                    (mul_pos
                      (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2))
                        (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 2)))
                      (Right.add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (Nat.cast_nonneg' 0)
                        (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_one)
                          (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 1)))))
                    (Mathlib.Meta.Positivity.pos_of_isNat (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_one)
                      (Eq.refl (Nat.ble 1 1)))))
                hδ0)
              hq1)
            hqr 0)
      else
        Roth.theta_lt_of_large_delta_aux✝
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg LE.le
                  (Eq.trans
                    (congrArg (HDiv.hDiv 1)
                      (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (CharP.cast_eq_zero ℝ 0)) 1) (zero_add 1)))
                    (div_self (of_eq_true (Eq.trans (congrArg Not one_ne_zero._simp_1) not_false_eq_true)))))
                δ))
            (LT.lt.le (not_le.mp hδ))))
    (fun n ih {δ} hδ0 {r q} hrlast hratio hq1 hqr ↦
      if hδ : δ ≤ 1 / (↑n + 1 + 1) then
        Roth.theta_lt_succ_aux✝ hδ0 hδ hrlast hratio
          (Eq.mp
            (congrFun'
              (congrArg LE.le
                (congrFun'
                  (congrArg HDiv.hDiv
                    (congr
                      (congrArg HMul.hMul
                        (congrFun'
                          (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (Eq.trans (Nat.cast_add n 1) (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd ↑n) Nat.cast_one))) 1))
                      (congrFun'
                        (congrArg HAdd.hAdd
                          (congrArg (HMul.hMul 2)
                            (congrFun'
                              (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (Eq.trans (Nat.cast_add n 1) (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd ↑n) Nat.cast_one)))
                              1)))
                        1)))
                  δ))
              (Real.log ↑(q 0)))
            hq1)
          hqr fun {δ} hδ0 x {r q} ↦ ih hδ0
      else
        Roth.theta_lt_of_large_delta_aux✝
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrFun'
                (congrArg LE.le
                  (congrArg (HDiv.hDiv 1)
                    (congrFun' (congrArg HAdd.hAdd (Eq.trans (Nat.cast_add n 1) (congrArg (HAdd.hAdd ↑n) Nat.cast_one)))
                      1)))
                δ))
            (LT.lt.le (not_le.mp hδ))))
    n hδ0 hrlast hratio hq1 hqr
